summary: Build roadmaps, score digital investments, and align technology with strategy. Learn practical tools for defensible prioritization and governance.
lede: Technology roadmapping and digital investment prioritization help professionals connect business goals with technology choices and funding priorities. For people who influence technology funding and transformation sequencing, the training covers capability mapping, current-state assessment, weighted initiative scoring, dependency mapping and phased roadmap design, helping them compare initiatives and prepare governance and executive reporting materials.
audienceIntro: This technology roadmapping and digital investment prioritization training is built for professionals who influence technology funding, roadmap design, and transformation sequencing. It suits people who need to move between business strategy, architecture constraints, and delivery realities while producing clear prioritization outputs.
prerequisites: To benefit fully from this course, you should have working familiarity with IT strategy, project or portfolio planning, and basic business case development. Experience with capability mapping, architecture review, or digital transformation governance will help, but no coding is required. You should bring a laptop for workshop exercises and be prepared to work with roadmap templates, prioritization matrices, and investment scoring worksheets.
topics: Project finance, appraisal & public investment management
